title: 第19章 人生的蜕变第20章 无能狂怒
slug: 赵老驴和杏花村的女人们
content_zh:
“你明明干啥了，我看见你被子一直在动。”李玉娇红着脸说道。
“我真的没有，我对天发誓我刚才没有……”
赵大柱汗流浃背，口不择言。
听到这犹如自爆卡车的话语，李玉娇再也忍不住了，扑哧一声笑了出来。
而赵大柱现在就像是一个犯错误的小学生，而且还被班主任老师盯着看，既慌张又紧张，完全不知道该怎么办了。
看着手足无措的赵大柱，李玉娇心头一动，便掀开被子从床上下来。
反正自己早就已经打定主意，通过这种方式报复王建国。
赵大柱又对自己这么好，这么体贴。
既然如此，那还有什么好犹豫的！
下定决心的李玉娇钻进了赵大柱的被窝里，斌说道：“让我来帮你吧。”
“你……你确定？玉娇，其实我不着急的……”赵大柱尴尬的说道。
“还说不着急呢，你看你都急成啥样了。”
李玉娇再次笑出了声。
既然李玉娇都已经做好准备了，那赵大柱也就咬咬牙不再犹豫。
一晚上功夫很快就过去了。
赵大柱平时是不睡懒觉的，但他今天破天荒的一觉睡到大中午。
没办法，他和李玉娇昨晚上一直折腾到后半夜三点多才终于睡下，不多睡一会儿补补觉肯定不行。
而且赵大柱醒过来之后刚刚睁开眼睛，就看到了距离自己不到十公分的精致漂亮的脸蛋。
欣赏着李玉娇细细的柳叶眉，长长的睫毛，红通通的嘴唇，赵大柱咽了一口唾沫就把嘴凑了过去，在李玉娇的唇上用力的亲了一口。
李玉娇于是也醒过来了，她一睁开眼睛就羞红了脸，又羞又恼的推开赵大柱。

“赵老头你真是的，我还没睡醒你就占我便宜……”李玉娇扭扭捏捏的说道，绯红的脸颊上洋溢着浓浓的羞意。
赵大柱挠着头嘿嘿嘿的傻笑，并说道：“我也不想，可我真的忍不住，玉娇你太美了，我一不留神就……”
“贫嘴。”
李玉娇用手指头在赵大柱的老脸上戳了一下，然后就拉了拉被子遮住自己白皙圆润的香肩。
回想着昨晚上的一幕幕，赵大柱心神激荡，觉得自己的人生终于圆满了。
他甚至想放声大喊——自己终于不是老光棍了！
“想什么呢？”李玉娇手撑着脑袋问道。
赵大柱毫不犹豫的说道：“玉娇，你看咱两都这样了，那你……你能不能叫我一声老公让我听听？”
“你才不是我老公哩。”李玉娇羞恼的说道。
“可咱两都已经有夫妻之实了。”赵大柱坚持道。
“别蹬鼻子上脸，我和你做这种事，只是……只是为了报复王建国而已，我可不是真的喜欢你。”李玉娇板着脸说道。
content_en:
"You obviously did something, I saw your quilt kept moving." Li Yujiao said with a red face.
"I really didn't, I swear to God I didn't just..."
Zhao Dazhu was sweating profusely and couldn't stop talking.
Hearing these words, which were like a self-destructing truck, Li Yujiao couldn't hold back anymore and burst into laughter.
And Zhao Dazhu is now like a primary school student who made a mistake and is being stared at by his homeroom teacher. He is panicked and nervous and has no idea what to do.
Seeing the helpless Zhao Dazhu, Li Yujiao's heart moved and she lifted the quilt and got off the bed.
Anyway, he had already made up his mind to take revenge on Wang Jianguo in this way.
Zhao Dazhu was so kind and considerate to him again.
In this case, there is nothing to hesitate about!
Determined, Li Yujiao got into Zhao Dazhu's bed and Bin said, "Let me help you."
"Are you...are you sure? Yujiao, actually I'm not in a hurry..." Zhao Dazhu said awkwardly.
"You're still saying you're not in a hurry. Look how anxious you are."
Li Yujiao laughed again.
Now that Li Yujiao was ready, Zhao Dazhu gritted his teeth and no longer hesitated.
The whole night passed quickly.
Zhao Dazhu usually doesn't sleep in, but today he slept until noon for the first time.
There was no other way. He and Li Yujiao had been tossing and tossing until about three o'clock in the middle of the night before finally falling asleep. It would definitely not work if they didn't sleep a little longer to catch up on their sleep.
And when Zhao Dazhu woke up and just opened his eyes, he saw a delicate and beautiful face less than ten centimeters away from him.
Admiring Li Yujiao's slender eyebrows, long eyelashes, and red lips, Zhao Dazhu swallowed and moved his mouth to Li Yujiao, kissing Li Yujiao hard on the lips.
Li Yujiao also woke up. As soon as she opened her eyes, she blushed and pushed Zhao Dazhu away in shame and annoyance.
"Old man Zhao, you are serious. You took advantage of me before I even woke up..." Li Yujiao said coquettishly, with deep shame on her crimson cheeks.
Zhao Dazhu scratched his head and giggled, and said: "I don't want to, but I really can't help it. Yujiao, you are so beautiful. If I don't pay attention, I will..."
"Poor mouth."
Li Yujiao poked Zhao Dazhu's old face with her finger, and then pulled the quilt to cover her fair and round shoulders.
Recalling the scenes last night, Zhao Dazhu was excited and felt that his life was finally complete.
He even wanted to shout loudly - he was finally no longer a bachelor!
"What are you thinking about?" Li Yujiao asked, holding her head in her hands.
Zhao Dazhu said without hesitation: "Yujiao, you see we are both like this, then you...can you call me husband so that I can listen?"
"You are not my husband." Li Yujiao said shyly and annoyed.
"But we are already married." Zhao Dazhu insisted.
"Don't push your nose or face. I'm doing this kind of thing with you just... just to get revenge on Wang Jianguo. I don't really like you." Li Yujiao said with a straight face.
